title: Adaptive market signals catalog for model provisioning and sourcing triggers
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a structured, prioritized catalog of external market signals that should trigger provisioning, procurement, or fallback actions for hosted/dedicated/private deployments. The artifact must be actionable for SRE/Infra, Sales (pricing/contracting), and Model Ops teams.
background: We lack a consolidated, machine-readable mapping between observable market events (model outages, license changes, major quantization releases, latency deltas, pricing shifts) and the internal provisioning/contracting playbooks. Fragmented notes live across Drive, PRDs, and engineering tickets, which slows response during supplier instability or rapid model shifts.
goals: 1) Enumerate high-fidelity external signals and thresholds. 2) Map each signal to recommended tactical actions (provision capacity, swap model variant, pause new onboarding, engage procurement). 3) Prioritize signals by impact / probability / detection lead time. 4) Deliver a draft catalog and a lightweight alerting rubric for Console/Runbooks.
success_criteria: - Catalog covering >=12 distinct signal classes with detection heuristics. - Each signal maps to at least one clear operational play with owner/team. - Triage latency (time from signal to recommended action) < 60 minutes in runbook hypotheticals. - PM/SRE/Procurement sign-off on catalog and alert rubric.
tasks: Interview SRE, Procurement, and Model Ops to capture historical incidents and manual triggers
Gather telemetry and external feeds (model-repo release notes, vendor pricing pages, status pages, social listening) and propose heuristics
Define detection thresholds and minimum reliable observability signals for each class
Map signals to response playbooks with clear owners and SLAs
Create a lightweight JSON schema for the catalog so it can be ingested into Console alerts
Pilot with two signal classes (model-supply outage, sudden price delta) and run tabletop exercise
Collect feedback and iterate; handoff to ENG for alert integration and to Sales/Procurement for contracting updates
acceptance_criteria: Draft catalog (JSON + human-readable doc) uploaded to Drive and linked in this ticket
Two pilot tabletop exercises completed with documented outcomes and action items
Runbook entries for pilot signals created and owners assigned
Lightweight alert rubric approved by SRE and Product within two cycles
notes: Trade-offs discussed: breadth vs signal quality. We prefer fewer high-precision signals to avoid alert fatigue.
Consideration: vendor legal/licensing deltas may require Procurement to own notification cadence rather than SRE.
Integration idea: expose catalog via /internal/market-signals API for Console to subscribe to
We will not attempt to auto-provision capacity on first pass; initial recommendations will be advisory with clear escalation paths
